    "import json\n"
    "import os\n"
    "import time\n"
    "from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional\n\n"
    "class MemoryVault:\n"
    "    \"\"\"v2 High-Performance JSONL Memory & Telemetry Vault.\"\"\"\n"
    "    def __init__(self, vault_path: str = \"vault.jsonl\"):\n"
    "        self.vault_path = vault_path\n"
    "        self._ensure_file()\n\n"
    "    def _ensure_file(self):\n"
    "        if not os.path.exists(self.vault_path):\n"
    "            with open(self.vault_path, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n"
    "                pass\n\n"
    "    def append(self, tag: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n"
    "        entry = {\n"
    "            \"timestamp\": time.time(),\n"
    "            \"tag\": tag,\n"
    "            \"payload\": payload\n"
    "        }\n"
    "        with open(self.vault_path, \"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n"
    "            f.write(json.dumps(entry) + \"\\n\")\n"
    "        return entry\n\n"
    "    def query(self, tag: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 50) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n"
    "        results = []\n"
    "        if not os.path.exists(self.vault_path):\n"
    "            return results\n"
    "        with open(self.vault_path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n"
    "            lines = f.readlines()\n"
    "        for line in reversed(lines):\n"
    "            line = line.strip()\n"
    "            if not line:\n"
    "                continue\n"
    "            try:\n"
    "                item = json.loads(line)\n"
    "                if tag is None or item.get(\"tag\") == tag:\n"
    "                    results.append(item)\n"
    "                    if len(results) >= limit:\n"
    "                        break\n"
    "            except json.JSONDecodeError:\n"
    "                continue\n"
    "        return list(reversed(results))\n"

files["sandbox.py"] = (
    "import asyncio\n"
    "import os\n"
    "import subprocess\n"
    "import sys\n"
    "import tempfile\n"
    "from typing import Dict, Any, Optional\n\n"
    "class ExecutionSandbox:\n"
    "    \"\"\"v2 Isolated Execution Engine & Process Sandbox.\"\"\"\n"
    "    def __init__(self, work_dir: Optional[str] = None, timeout: float = 30.0):\n"
    "        self.work_dir = work_dir or tempfile.gettempdir()\n"
    "        self.timeout = timeout\n\n"
    "    async def execute_code(self, code: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n"
    "        temp_script = os.path.join(self.work_dir, f\"execution_{int(asyncio.get_event_loop().time()*1000)}.py\")\n"
    "        with open(temp_script, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n"
    "            f.write(code)\n\n"
    "        try:\n"
    "            proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(\n"
    "                sys.executable, temp_script,\n"
    "                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,\n"
    "                stderr=subprocess.PIPE\n"
    "            )\n\n"
    "            try:\n"
    "                stdout_bytes, stderr_bytes = await asyncio.wait_for(proc.communicate(), timeout=self.timeout)\n"
    "                return {\n"
    "                    \"exit_code\": proc.returncode,\n"
    "                    \"stdout\": stdout_bytes.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'),\n"
    "                    \"stderr\": stderr_bytes.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'),\n"
    "                    \"timed_out\": False\n"
    "                }\n"
    "            except asyncio.TimeoutError:\n"
    "                proc.kill()\n"
    "                await proc.wait()\n"
    "                return {\n"
    "                    \"exit_code\": -1,\n"
    "                    \"stdout\": \"\",\n"
    "                    \"stderr\": f\"Execution timed out after {self.timeout} seconds.\",\n"
    "                    \"timed_out\": True\n"
    "                }\n"
    "        finally:\n"
    "            if os.path.exists(temp_script):\n"
    "                os.remove(temp_script)\n"
)

    "import asyncio\n"

    "import os\n"
    "import sys\n"
    "from vault import MemoryVault\n"
    "from sandbox import ExecutionSandbox\n\n"
    "class EvolutionaryRunner:\n"
    "    \"\"\"v2 Core Agent Runner with Async Telemetry & Execution State Machine.\"\"\"\n"
    "    def __init__(self, vault_path: str = \"vault_v2.jsonl\"):\n"
    "        self.vault = MemoryVault(vault_path)\n"
    "        self.sandbox = ExecutionSandbox()\n"
    "        self.tick_count = 0\n\n"
    "    async def run_tick(self, task_payload: dict) -> dict:\n"
    "        self.tick_count += 1\n"
    "        self.vault.append(\"TICK_START\", {\"tick\": self.tick_count, \"task\": task_payload})\n"
    "        \n"
    "        code = task_payload.get(\"code\", \"print('Tick execution default')\")\n"
    "        exec_res = await self.sandbox.execute_code(code)\n"
    "        \n"
    "        status = \"SUCCESS\" if exec_res[\"exit_code\"] == 0 else \"FAILURE\"\n"
    "        self.vault.append(\"TICK_END\", {\n"
    "            \"tick\": self.tick_count,\n"
    "            \"status\": status,\n"
    "            \"result\": exec_res\n"
    "        })\n"
    "        \n"
    "        return {\n"
    "            \"tick\": self.tick_count,\n"
    "            \"status\": status,\n"
    "            \"execution\": exec_res\n"
    "        }\n\n"
    "async def main():\n"
    "    runner = EvolutionaryRunner()\n"

def bootstrap_evolution_v2():
    staging_dirs = ["/evolution_v2", "./evolution_v2"]

    for stg in staging_dirs:
        try:
            os.makedirs(stg, exist_ok=True)
            for file_name, content in files.items():
                target_path = os.path.join(stg, file_name)
                with open(target_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    f.write(content)
            print(f"Successfully bootstrapped evolution_v2 at {stg}", file=sys.stderr)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Notice: Could not write to {stg}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)

    # Validate test suite in active staging directory
    test_dir = "/evolution_v2" if os.path.exists("/evolution_v2") else "./evolution_v2"
    test_file = os.path.join(test_dir, "test_v2.py")

    print(f"Running validation suite on {test_file}...", file=sys.stderr)
    res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "test_v2.py"], cwd=test_dir, capture_output=True, text=True)

    print("Test Suite Output STDERR:\n" + res.stderr, file=sys.stderr)

    output_summary = {
        "status": "BOOTSTRAP_SUCCESSFUL" if res.returncode == 0 else "TESTS_FAILED",
        "staging_directory": test_dir,
        "test_return_code": res.returncode,
        "files_created": list(files.keys())
    }

    print(json.dumps(output_summary, indent=2))
    if res.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(res.returncode)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    bootstrap_evolution_v2()
